segments.title: An octopus has three hearts
segments.say: An octopus has three hearts. And blue blood.

segments.title: Two hearts pump the gills
segments.say: Two hearts push blood past the gills.

segments.title: The third one stops
segments.say: The third feeds the body, and it stops beating when the octopus swims.

segments.title: Its blood is blue
segments.say: Its blood is blue, because it carries oxygen with copper, not iron.

segments.title: Its arms think too
segments.say: Bonus: two thirds of its neurons are in its arms, not its head.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Three hearts, or brains in your arms? Which would you pick? Comment below, and follow Nexora.
